summary: Customer manufactures tablets from a powder blend containing an API and excipients. They currently rely on laboratory checks after the press and want to assess whether a fiber based measurement in the feed frame could follow API concentration changes. Their first pilot should compare reasonable measurement options before committing to production equipment.
